title: mac-slot reads the load under the caller's locale: with a decimal-comma locale every reading is unreadable, so the first read fails open and the load cap never applies
evidence: tools/mac-slot.sh load() ran `sysctl -n vm.loadavg` without LC_ALL=C; under de_DE.UTF-8 it printed "{ 6,44 37,19 64,92 }" (measured in review of PR 1424). Fixed: load() runs LC_ALL=C sysctl. Pin tools/mac-slot.test.ts "reads the real load under a decimal-comma locale (lead T17)" runs the real sysctl under de_DE with a cap of 0: before the fix it failed open and ran (exit 0, expected 75); after, it reads the load and refuses
